summary:
I built M1 (Funds & companies, BRD A1 and A4). Every file is inside my ownership list. My files typecheck with no errors, ESLint is clean on my paths, and the 112 M1 tests pass. I could not run the pages against the live app, so they are checked by server-render tests with mocked data, not in a browser.

Pages:
- **/admin/funds**: every ScaleUp role can view it. It shows each fund's code, name, legal name, description, active or inactive, and its company counts (total and active); the count links to /admin/companies?fund=<CODE>. Super Admins add and edit funds in a dialog. The code is upper-cased and must be unique; a duplicate code is shown next to the code field.
- **/admin/companies**: every company with its fund codes, sector, status, reporting start (or "Not yet reporting"), latest month status and partner-in-charge. You can search by name or legal name and filter by fund, status, partner (including "No partner assigned") and reporting. Filtering happens in the browser and is kept in the URL (?q=&fund=&status=&partner=&reporting=yes|no). A summary line and empty states are included, and Super Admins get "Add company".
- **/admin/companies/new** (Super Admin): profile, reporting currency (default MYR), optional start month with a preview of which months open and when they are due, partner-in-charge (active partners and Super Admins) and fund rows. It checks the input in the browser first, then on the server. After creating the company it saves the partner-in-charge, inserts the fund rows and, if a start month was given, calls open_due_periods().
- **/admin/companies/[companyId]?tab=…**: seven tabs; each tab loads only its own data inside a loading placeholder and an error boundary with "Try again".
  - Overview: key-facts tiles (funds, partner, latest month, rating), the profile (editable by Super Admin, read-only otherwise), the reporting start month with an explanation (set, change or clear; clearing asks for confirmation), status actions (exited or written off with a required reason, back to active), and delete.
  - Delete asks for a reason and the typed company name, which the server checks again. It calls delete_company, then removes everything under "<company_id>/" in company-documents with the service-role storage API (it walks the folders page by page and removes in batches). If the file removal fails, the company is still deleted and the admin sees a warning; the error is logged.
  - Funds & investment: add, edit and remove fund mappings (Super Admin).
  - Revenue lines: add, rename, reorder, deactivate or reactivate, and delete only when the line has no figures (Super Admin and Fund Admin).
  - KPIs: the KPI table (name, description, unit, type, frequency, dimension, required, active, order) plus dimensions with their members.
  - Team: read-only member list; Super Admins get "Manage users" linking to /admin/users?company=<id>.
  - Internal (ScaleUp only): partner picker for Super Admins; rating, exit status, exit notes and notes for whoever canEditInternal allows; read-only for others; shows "last updated … by …".
  - Monthly updates: status, overdue days, due date and original due date, submitted and approved dates, revision, narrative filled or skipped, open threads, a link to /admin/review/<id>, and "Edit on behalf" to /admin/companies/<id>/updates/<YYYY-MM> for Fund Admins on draft or sent-back months of active companies.

All Server Actions are in src/app/admin/companies/actions.ts and src/app/admin/funds/actions.ts. Each one checks the role, validates with zod, writes through the normal row-level-security client, and revalidates the affected pages.
deviations: KPI dimensions: the kpi_dimensions table has no sort_order or is_active columns, so dimensions can only be added, renamed and deleted (deletion is allowed only when no KPI uses the dimension and its members have no figures). Dimension members support add, rename, reorder, deactivate or reactivate, and delete when they have no figures.

deleteCompanyAction does not call revalidatePath. In Next 16 any revalidation in a Server Action re-renders the current page, which is the deleted company, so it would briefly show a 404. Instead the client shows a toast and navigates to /admin/companies with router.replace; the list page is dynamic, so it is rendered fresh.

Extra app-level rules the database does not enforce: (1) a reporting start month must fall between platform_settings.default_reporting_start (Jul 2026) and 12 months after the current month; an existing value outside that range can be kept. (2) The reporting currency is locked once the company has saved or submitted figures. (3) Once a KPI has figures, its value type can only change between the number types and its dimension cannot change. (4) Inactive funds cannot be chosen for new fund mappings. (5) The partner-in-charge must be an active partner or Super Admin (the database accepts any profile).

Creating a company is not a single transaction. The company row is inserted first; if assigning the partner, inserting the fund mappings or calling open_due_periods fails, the company is still created and the failures come back as warnings, so the admin can finish on the company page.

The companies list looks back 6 months in v_submission_overview for each company's latest month, to keep the query small. A company whose newest month is older than that (for example one that exited long ago) shows a dash.
Moving an existing fund mapping to another fund is not supported: the fund is fixed when editing, so the admin removes the mapping and adds a new one.
Returning a company to active does not require a reason, and afterwards open_due_periods() is called so any months it missed open straight away.
Funds can be created, edited and deactivated but not deleted (the brief only asked for create and edit).
Page props are typed explicitly as the brief asked, not with the generated PageProps.
verification:
- `npx tsc --noEmit`: no errors in my files; confirmed with --listFilesOnly that they are part of the check. On the final run the whole project had 2 errors, both in tests/features/m9/render.test.ts (M9's work in progress).
- `npx eslint` on all my paths (src/app/admin/funds, the companies page, loading, actions, _components, new and [companyId] files, and tests/features/m1): clean, no warnings.
- `npx vitest run tests/features/m1`: 9 files, 112 tests passed:
  - pure helpers: filters and URL handling, zod schemas and normalisers, reordering, KPI locks, start-month range and preview, storage folder walking and batched removal, tabs and labels, fund schema;
  - Server Actions with a fake Supabase client: role refusals, the exact rows each action writes, open_due_periods side effects, duplicate-name field errors, partial-failure warnings, the typed-name check on delete, storage removed only for that company's folder and only after the RPC succeeds, the warning when storage removal fails, the KPI lock, and partner-in-charge rules for internal fields;
  - server-render smoke tests of every tab, the companies list, the funds table and the Add company form, each for the roles that matter.
- `npx vitest run` (whole repo): 1179 of 1180 tests passed. The one failure is in tests/features/m6/render.test.ts (M6's work in progress).
- Not run: `next build` and `next typegen`, as instructed.
openQuestions: Should start months before July 2026 be allowed? The database supports earlier months (open_due_periods uses min(default, company start)), but the app currently refuses them because BRD B3 says earlier history comes from the workbook migration. Relaxing this is a one-line change in reporting.ts startMonthBounds.
BRD open item: should Fund Admins also be able to add companies? This build follows the matrix: Super Admin only.
Currency lock: is locking the reporting currency after any saved or submitted figures the right rule, or should it lock only once a month is submitted?
Should funds that hold no companies be deletable? Currently only deactivation is offered.
notesForOtherModules: Routes M1 exposes: /admin/funds; /admin/companies with ?q=<text>&fund=<FUND CODE, e.g. SV1>&status=active|exited|written_off&partner=<profile uuid|none>&reporting=yes|no; /admin/companies/new (Super Admin only); /admin/companies/<companyId>?tab=overview|funds|revenue|kpis|team|internal|updates (the Overview has no ?tab). For back links, e.g. M5 and M6 returning to a company's months, use /admin/companies/<id>?tab=updates, or companyTabHref(id, 'updates') from src/app/admin/companies/[companyId]/_components/tabs.ts.

M2 (users): the Team tab links Super Admins to /admin/users?company=<companyId> ('Manage users' / 'Invite users'). Please make /admin/users read ?company=<uuid> and pre-filter to that company, ideally with an 'Invite owner' action for it.

M6 (review): the companies list ('Latest month') and the Monthly updates tab link to /admin/review/<submissionId> for every status, drafts included (labelled 'Open', or 'Review' when submitted). The review page should handle draft and changes-requested months gracefully.

M5 (on-behalf form): 'Edit on behalf' links to /admin/companies/<companyId>/updates/<YYYY-MM>. It is shown only when canEnterData(ctx, companyId, company.status) is true (Fund Admin, active company) and the month is draft or changes_requested. My [companyId]/loading.tsx wraps the updates/[month] subtree, but your own loading.tsx there takes precedence.
M7 (tracker): company links should go to /admin/companies/<id>. M1 actions call revalidatePath('/admin/tracker') after changes to the company list, status, reporting start or partner.

Reusable piece: SectionErrorBoundary in src/app/admin/companies/_components/section-error-boundary.tsx, built on catchError from 'next/error', gives a section-level error with 'Try again'. It is already used by /admin/funds.
F-AUTH (optional): an src/app/admin/error.tsx would give friendly fallbacks for errors outside my section boundaries, e.g. if loading the company header fails.

F-DB (optional hardening): three rules currently enforced only in M1's actions could become database triggers so they hold for every writer: (1) companies.reporting_currency cannot change once the company has non-draft or saved submissions; (2) company_kpis.value_type cannot change storage group, and dimension_id cannot change, once submission_kpi_values rows exist; (3) a reporting start month range check.

Integrator: please add BRD §13 build decisions for rules introduced here (I can't edit the BRD): the reporting start month range (from the platform default reporting start to 12 months ahead); the currency lock once figures exist; the KPI type and dimension lock once figures exist; and that deleting a company also removes its uploaded files from storage (audit log and user accounts are kept). No nav, proxy or DB changes are needed: the sidebar already links Companies and Funds, and all routes are behind the admin guard. Run next typegen as usual; page props are typed explicitly.
